plan.scope: Sequential tiny then medium in the same official SDK worker runner. Three fixed crops selected for known tiny-reader errors, followed by the same four familiar development receipts (five whole-image panels). Crops are not independent receipts or a holdout. Original fifty untouched. No labels or earlier OCR supplied to either recognizer. Model caches reused without writing new weight archives. No new app default or provider integration.
plan.scoring: Unchanged existing financial labels/config/scorer and frozen current parser; automatic and separately supplied currency remain separate. Selected crops scored only for two literal tax-code rows and two VAT-legend rates; names reported as exact strings. No crop tuning, glyph repair, financial edits or checks cleared.
plan.timing: Warm prediction/decode after fixed synthetic gate, plus separately reported initialization and guarded process lifetime. One run per arm, not robust p95 or physical-phone measurements. Owned development process-tree peak is sampled, not model-only memory.

actual_start.startup_guard_basis: Prior sampled medium browser tree peak plus 1 GiB reserve, identical for both study arms
actual_start.scope: Experimental single-browser resource guard, not a vendor requirement or guarantee of peak memory fit. Local synthetic input plus optional fixed receipt cohort. Observer is a sibling, process tree contains development tools and browser, not model-only memory or a phone measurement.

scope: Versioned plan and stale-input rejection, preserving all model/image/parameter/reference/guard choices. No new OCR, accuracy, latency, or model-only memory result. Both image arms, paired replay and financial scoring remain unexecuted.
